name: pattern_volume:log-cart-app-warn
query:
fetch logs, from: -7d, samplingRatio: 100
| filter service.name == "cart" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "WARN"
| fieldsAdd sift.pattern = if(matchesPhrase(content, "Timeout calling inventory"), "log-cart-app-warn-timeout-calling-inventory-65c2", else: "other")
| summarize records = count() * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio), content_chars = sum(stringLength(content)) * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio), by:{sift.pattern}
